text:
Supporting our servicemembers and veterans has been a priority throughout our time in Congress.

✅ Secured $944.82 million in military authorizations and extensions for South Carolina’s key military installations, including Marine Corps Recruit Depot (MCRD) Parris Island, Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Beaufort, and Joint Base Charleston.
✅ Supported $30.4 million in authorization for a new VA clinic in Beaufort County.
✅ Secured provisions in the House-passed defense bill to restore critical services at Naval Hospital Beaufort.
✅ Helped secure the 218th signature to force a House vote on the Major Richard Star Act, so combat-injured veterans receive their full retirement and disability benefits.
✅ Supported a $212 million investment in U.S. Coast Guard Base Charleston.
✅ Introduced dozens of bills to hold the VA accountable, expand access to the care veterans and servicemembers deserve, protect military families and children, and restore merit in our armed forces.

As we transition from one office to the next, our commitment remains unchanged. We will keep standing with our troops, veterans, and military families.

God bless our troops, and God bless America.
